# Format Studio workspace instructions

- Frontend: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Framer Motion.
- Backend: FastAPI with route modules under `backend/routes` and services under `backend/services`.
- Keep browser-first image conversion private; server APIs handle documents, OCR, background removal, and batch jobs.
- Prefer focused, accessible UI controls and preserve the existing visual language.
- Run `npm --prefix frontend run lint` and `npm --prefix frontend run build` after frontend changes.
